name: Guangzhou Guangri Stock Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Guangri Stock Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells elevators and related parts in China. The company engages in the design, production, installation, repair, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, and moving walkways; and design and production of elevator electrical components and related electrical products, elevator guide rails, and related spare parts. It also provides third-party logistics services, including transportation, distribution, warehousing, packaging, and processing. In addition, The company is involved in the digital intelligence business; smart parking services, such as vertical lift, planar moving, lift-and-slide, and simple lift, as well as parking garage solutions…
